component.name: omaforge
component.summary: Install and update World of Warcraft addons

description.p: omaforge finds every World of Warcraft client in your Wine, Proton, Lutris, Bottles and Heroic prefixes and shows what each one has installed, including addons it did not install itself.

ul.li: Retail, Classic, Classic Era and every PTR and beta
Install and update addons from CurseForge, WoWInterface and GitHub
Search and explore popular addons for each game version
Back up and restore your WTF settings
A command line for scripts, timers and keybindings

description.p: Made for Omarchy, where it follows the desktop theme, and at home on any Linux desktop.

screenshot.caption: Installed addons for Retail, with two updates waiting
